title: Invoices Within Reach of a Patient Financial Assistance Program Award: Billing Classes and Balance Terms by Tier
content:
An award under the Patient Financial Assistance Program discounts patient invoices of the billing classes its tier lists, subject to the balance terms below. The two tables together give every tier's terms.

## Billing classes the award discounts

| Tier | Self-Pay Patient Invoice | Insured Patient Responsibility Invoice | Out-of-Network Balance Invoice | Medicare Beneficiary Liability Invoice | Medicaid Copay Invoice | Consumer Test Purchase Invoice |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Financial Assistance 25% Discount | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | No |
| Financial Assistance 50% Discount | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | No |
| Financial Assistance 75% Discount | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | No |
| Financial Assistance Full Discount | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | No |
| Presumptive Eligibility Full Discount | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | No |
| Catastrophic Medical Hardship Adjustment | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | No | No |

## Balance terms

| Tier | Consumer test purchases can be discounted | Patient responsibility left after insurance is eligible | Invoice discounted only after every claim for its order is finally adjudicated | Mobile-visit and other collection-service fees discounted | Invoices carried on a payment plan discounted (plan balance reduced) | Prompt-pay discount may still be taken on the balance left after the assistance discount |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Financial Assistance 25% Discount | No | Yes | Yes | No | Yes | Yes |
| Financial Assistance 50% Discount | No | Yes | Yes | No | Yes | Yes |
| Financial Assistance 75% Discount | No | Yes | Yes | No | Yes | Yes |
| Financial Assistance Full Discount | No | Yes | Yes | No | Yes | Yes |
| Presumptive Eligibility Full Discount | No | Yes | Yes | No | Yes | Yes |
| Catastrophic Medical Hardship Adjustment | No | Yes | Yes | No | Yes | No |

## Where the tiers differ

- The Catastrophic Medical Hardship Adjustment does not list the Medicaid Copay Invoice among its billing classes; every other tier lists five classes, that one included.
- Under the Catastrophic Medical Hardship Adjustment a prompt-pay discount may not be taken on the balance left after the assistance discount; under every other tier it may.
- No tier discounts consumer test purchases or collection-service fees, and every tier waits for every claim on the order to be finally adjudicated.
